title: Rainy Abandoned Theater
description: A man in a dark suit sits at a wooden desk with a green lamp and vintage radio, writing in a notebook inside a dilapidated theater. Rain pours through a broken skylight onto the flooded floor as a long decaying hallway with red exit signs stretches into the background beside a red-curtained stage.
prompt: A lone man in a dark suit sits at a wooden desk with a glowing green banker's lamp and old radio, writing in a notebook inside a vast decaying theater interior. Heavy rain falls through a shattered skylight creating puddles on the wooden floor. To the left is a small red-curtained stage with a single chair, to the right a long dilapidated hallway with peeling wallpaper and glowing red exit signs. Cinematic lighting, moody atmosphere, highly detailed digital painting.
